name: Agrimin Limited
summary: Agrimin Limited engages in the exploration and development of mineral properties in Australia. It holds a 100% interest in the Mackay Potash project comprising nine granted exploration licenses covering a total area of 3,057 square kilometers located in Western Australia; and three exploration license applications covering an area of 1,240 square kilometers located in the Northern Territory. The company was formerly known as Global Resources Corporation Limited and changed its name to Agrimin Limited in December 2014. Agrimin Limited is based in Nedlands, Australia.
